subject: keyboard-framework
text: - A falsy Dioxus value (Bool false, Text `"false"`, Int 0, Float 0.0, None) of one of the bridge's 28 boolean attributes — upstream's private `is_bool_attr` predicate, a closed `matches!` set, since 2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship, which retired the bridge's own 27-name `BOOLEAN_ATTRIBUTES` list and left `mutation_writer.rs` byte-identical to upstream's at `434e0661`; `disabled`, `checked`, `hidden`, `readonly`, `required`, `multiple`, `selected`, `open`, `autofocus` and `inert` among them — removes the attribute, on the dynamic and the static template attribute path alike, so an enabled Dioxus control does not match `:disabled` and an element rendered `hidden: false` carries no `hidden` attribute, is laid out and stays in the accessibility tree and the snapshot, while a truthy `hidden` still excludes it (§4); a truthy value of a listed name is still written, and an attribute outside the list holding `false` (`aria-hidden`, a `data-` attribute) is still written as `"false"`; a framework-written `inert: false` is removed — `inert` the 28th name `dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs` reads since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness — while a truthy `inert` takes focusability, hits and the tree away from its subtree (Focus order above; §6 Visibility and hit-testing; ratified by the founder (2026-10-18)) and Tab reaches the buttons under `inert: false` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:1027-1054; tests/blitz-tests/tests/inert_subtree.rs:77-363; packages/dioxus-native-dom/src/mutation_writer.rs:439-475; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_disabled.rs:24-39; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs.rs:57-80; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs.rs:130-150; tests/blitz-tests/tests/dioxus_falsy_boolean_attrs.rs:173-208) — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-06-snapshot-state-fidelity/report.md and, for the 28-name predicate, escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-upstream-sync-polish-and-ship/report.md

text: - seven_guis CRUD: since 2026-10-10-snapshot-states the person rows are `option`s of a `listbox` by `role` attribute and are not focusable (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:58; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:96-97 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-10-snapshot-states/report.md); since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness the list `crud-list` takes `tabindex="0"` and an `onkeydown` — the third CRUD Tab stop — and, focused, ArrowDown selects the next visible row (the first when none is selected), ArrowUp the previous, Home the first and End the last, each setting the selection and the two fields as a row's click does, a key at the end of the list or ArrowUp with no row selected changing nothing; the tree's focus is the list, never the option — the builder reads no `aria-activedescendant`, so an assistive technology learns the current row only from its `selected` reading — recorded, not closed: an `aria-activedescendant` read in the builder, or a roving focus, is SC 4.1.2 work outside the tier-0 target, kept unread on the founder's F2 «Оставить записанным (Рекомендую)» (2026-10-14, by question dialog in the overseer session, relayed by the overseer as his chosen option label) and pinned by `accessibility_active_descendant_unread` (ratified by the founder, 2026-10-18) (tests/blitz-tests/tests/accessibility_active_descendant_unread.rs:39-81) (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:60-87; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:92; examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:173-179; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:932-992) — the operator's decision, as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the list is named `People` by `aria-label` (examples/seven_guis/src/tasks/crud.rs:59 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md)

subject: keyboard-harness
text:
- A keyboard check runs on the stand in both layout modes, since 2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness: `stand_keyboard` walks each lean task's stated sequence (`tab_order`) forward and back with Tab and Shift+Tab, with wrap, the engine's focus, the snapshot's `focused` node and the tree's focus agreeing at every step — the engine's reading with the root element dropped, because `get_focussed_node_id` / `Harness::focused()` falls back to the root when nothing is focused and never reads `None` (packages/blitz-dom/src/document.rs:659-662); Enter and Space on each focused stand button read as its click (16 rows) and keys that do not activate type or change nothing; fixture rows for the controls HTML gives the keys, a button disabled after it took focus taking no key and a button that is itself scrolled taking Enter as its own click; a click focusing each stand button with Tab continuing from it; a `disabled` attribute skipping a form control and not a `<div disabled tabindex=0>`; the CRUD list taking focus and its keys moving the selection; the Apple delete binding deleting on every OS; and an inert subtree skipped by Tab (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:337-365; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:367-423; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:710-789; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:850-877; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:889-930; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:932-992; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:994-1011; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:1027-1054); its readers `tab_order` and `focused` live in the stand checks' shared module (tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:47-63; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:99-119); through the driver `stand_act_keys` presses `enter` and `space` on a Tab-focused `counter-increment` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_act_keys.rs:131-165)
 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-13-stand-keyboard-harness/report.md; since 2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions the walk is also asserted in two enabled states, each reached by keyboard alone (`enable_by_keyboard`) and walked in order against the shared table `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` — the flight booker after the return flight is chosen on `select#flight-type` by ArrowDown, five stops: `back-btn`, `flight-type`, `flight-start`, `flight-return-date`, `flight-book` (its boot `tab_order` `back-btn` → `flight-type` → `flight-start` → `flight-book`); CRUD after a row is selected, eight: `back-btn`, `crud-filter`, `crud-list`, `crud-name`, `crud-surname`, `crud-create`, `crud-update`, `crud-delete` — every `controls(task)` id over `LeanTask::ALL` lies in `tab_order` ∪ `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER`, asserted as an empty set difference — the select alone standing in the tables, its two options taking no focus —, and Enter and Space on the controls enabled later give 4 rows (Keyboard handling above); `ENABLED_TAB_ORDER` lives in the shared module beside `tab_order` and `focused` (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:425-459; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:523-554; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:610-628; tests/blitz-tests/tests/common/mod.rs:65-91 — as measured at escher-0.1.0/chunks/2026-10-14-stand-a11y-assertions/report.md)
 — `stand_keyboard` also walks the load page's `LOAD_TAB_ORDER` and Cells' `CELLS_TAB_ORDER` forward and back in both layout modes, with the load page's button taking Enter and Space, Cells' arrows and Enter opening the moved-to cell's editor and its value committing by keyboard, Tab leaving an open editor and a click on another cell each committing it, and the arrows clamping at the grid's ends and bringing a cell into view (tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:157-177; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:193-200; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:202-249; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:251-268; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:270-291; tests/blitz-tests/tests/stand_keyboard.rs:293-335 — as measured at escher-0.3.0/chunks/2026-10-31-engine-debts/report.md)
